about: Declared route guards. Held to the live app by scripts/security/__tests__/routeGuardRegistry.test.js. Regenerate with scripts/security/writeRouteGuardRegistry.js and review the diff.

exceptions.reason: Liveness/readiness probes are not rate limited (loopback/health-token gated instead).
Ops-token-only by design (docs/security/RBAC_MODEL.md §6); READ_METRICS/READ_DIAGNOSTICS are planned.
An operator manages only their OWN MFA enrolment; enrol is refused once enrolled, reset needs MANAGE_USERS + step-up.

Every reject before the artifact signature verifies is counter+sampled-log only (qodiqa_preauth_rejects_total); audit/transparency writes happen only after verification. /verify writes only the lazy keystore bootstrap.
The only write is the keystore creating its first key when none exists (process bootstrap, not caller-controlled, idempotent).
Proof lookup persists deterministic Merkle block checkpoints (INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING); bounded by the log size, rate limited.

Anonymous calls are ephemeral (nothing persisted); only a caller authenticated through the full admin stack with the write permission persists. A presented-but-invalid credential is refused. Proven in publicVerifyEphemeral.test.js.

Tenant-portal login endpoints (OIDC callback; dev stub refused in production by boot rule) create the session user by design; portal-only (QODIQA_PORTAL_ENABLED). The write goes to the control plane (PostgreSQL), no longer to a file.
